name: sun-camera-turn
about: The sun must not move when the camera turns (2026-10-14). A WOW-HC player saw the shadows change as they turned the camera: the sun was read from the sprite the sky draws, and the sky draws only the sprites in view, so with the sun out of view a moon was taken for the sun. The sun now comes from the clock's table (src/sunpath.cpp). At 11:45 the camera looks at the sun, away from it, and up; at 01:30 away from the moons and at them. In every probe the volumetric light's sun must be the table's: azimuth 45, elevation 82.5 by day (0.09 0.09 0.99), the larger moon at 31.3 at night (0.60 0.60 0.52).

start.about: Elwynn's ridges (the elwynn-ridge-fog start), on the ground, first person, open sky

expect.about: 11:45, the camera at the sun: the table's sun
11:45, the camera away from the sun: the same sun
11:45, the camera toward the moons' side: the same sun
01:30, the camera away from the moons: the larger moon
01:30, the camera at the moons: the same moon

expect.probe: ^sun: the table at 01:3\d:.*the light follows the larger moon
expect.about: 01:30: the light follows the larger moon
